units.note: 天台全景（水塔/晾衣绳·城在脚下）
units.i2v_prompt: Single continuous take at 24fps, 16:9. A medium wide shot at eye level; the camera holds the same wide framing from the first frame to the last, the whole rooftop and the boy small and centred in the frame. A young man in a washed denim jacket standing on a Taipei rooftop at dusk among strung clotheslines and a water tower, the whole city bowl dim and warm below the parapet, his gaze drifting off past the camera toward the sky above the city. The bare concrete rooftop floor along the bottom of the frame carries only worn grey concrete and its stains. The frame carries only the rooftop, the water tower, the strung clothes and the open dusk sky. Warm 2000 Taiwanese telecine grade, warm skin tones, milky lifted blacks. Visible 35mm film grain. Restrained continuous motion, camera and subject motion only. His jaw is blunt and rounded, his nose tip flat and wide, his eyelids heavy and single-lidded, his skin matte and unretouched.
